title: Setting Up a New Account
blurb: From registration to a ready-to-talk device, step by step

slides.title: Setting Up a New Account
slides.text: Setting Up a New Account From registration to a ready-to-talk device, step by step

slides.title: Before we start
slides.text: Before we start What makes Bravo different  Two interfaces Separate Tap and Scan experiences, each built for its user  Expressive mascots Engaging characters, not plain stick figures  Wake Word Partners start a conversation just by speaking  Consent-first AI Personal suggestions, with parents in control

slides.title: Roadmap
slides.text: Roadmap The setup at a glance Create the account Login → Register Device setup: 10 steps Interface Mode Mascot Wake Word Button Layout Menu Options User Language Partner Voice Age & Consent Personalized Learning Profile Interview Highlighted: child protection steps. For users under 13, steps 9 and 10 unlock only after a parent consents.

slides.title: Create the account
slides.text: Create the account Start at the login screen New to Bravo? Tap Register here .

slides.title: Create the account
slides.text: Create the account Register, with sharing built in Therapist/Admin email: an SLP can manage the account without sharing the login I am a therapist: this account can access client accounts Allow Bravo Admin: Bravo can help with support

slides.title: Interface Mode
slides.text: Interface Mode One app, two purpose-built screens Tap Scan

slides.title: Interface Mode
slides.text: Interface Mode Built for two kinds of users Tap: a touch-based picture grid Scan: automatic scanning with a switch or key

slides.title: Tap only
slides.text: Tap only Choose a Mascot Characters with real expression Bobby, Bonnie or Buddy , or no mascot at all Expressive and engaging, not plain stick figures

slides.title: Tap only
slides.text: Tap only Button Layout Size the grid to fit the user Pick buttons per row and number of rows Fewer buttons = bigger targets Dynamic row: AI keeps generating options

slides.title: Tap only
slides.text: Tap only Menu Options Choose the built-in menus Every menu comes with a ready-made board Uncheck a menu to hide it Things has sub-menus, from Clothes to Tools

slides.title: Scan only
slides.text: Scan only Button Layout & Options Buttons, AI options and Freestyle Buttons per row Fewer means bigger buttons, a good start for beginners Number of AI options Choices an AI-prompt button generates. 0 turns them off. Freestyle options Words and phrases shown at once on the Freestyle page

slides.title: Scan only
slides.text: Scan only Scanning Configuration Tune the scan to the user Scan mode: Auto at a set speed, or Step on each switch press Scan delay: 3500 ms = 3.5 seconds per option Wait for switch: start only after a press Chime: a sound when a new page appears Loop limit: times through the page. 0 = no limit.

slides.title: Tap + Scan
slides.text: Tap + Scan Wake Word Start a conversation by name Interjection + name = “hey Bobby” Then ask the user a question or share a comment

slides.title: Tap + Scan
slides.text: Tap + Scan User Language The language the user sees Sets the words on buttons, labels and speech history Includes Spanish, French, Arabic and more

slides.title: Tap + Scan
slides.text: Tap + Scan Partner Language & Voice The voice everyone hears Can differ from the on-screen language Child or adult, female or male voices Tap Test Voice to hear it first

slides.title: Tap + Scan
slides.text: Tap + Scan  Built to protect children For users under 13, a parent consents before Bravo learns anything about them.

slides.title: Tap + Scan
slides.text: Tap + Scan Age & Parental Consent Under 13? A parent decides. Select Under 13 Enter the parent’s email and tap Send Email

slides.title: Tap + Scan
slides.text: Tap + Scan Age & Parental Consent The request is on its way The button turns green and reads Sent Tap Next and keep setting up

slides.title: Tap + Scan
slides.text: Tap + Scan The parent’s view Clear promises, one tap to confirm 1. The consent email 2. After tapping Confirm consent No selling data, no training AI models, no ads Consent can be withdrawn at any time

slides.title: Tap + Scan
slides.text: Tap + Scan Personalized Learning Check for consent in real time Parent confirms, you tap Check for Consent Setup continues, no restart needed

slides.title: Tap + Scan
slides.text: Tap + Scan Personalized Learning Parents control what Bravo learns Unlocks only after consent Auto-approve: facts added automatically Require approval: review each fact first

slides.title: Tap + Scan
slides.text: Tap + Scan User Profile Interview A profile for more personal options 15 short questions, about 5–10 minutes Unlocks only after consent Skip now, run later from User Information

slides.title: Setup complete
slides.text: Setup complete Ready to talk  Account registered  Device set up  Parental consent on record Tap Scan

title: Why Does Bravo Have 2 Different Interfaces?
blurb: A deeper look at Tap and Scan

slides.title: Why does Bravo have 2 different interfaces?
slides.text: Why does Bravo have 2 different interfaces? A deeper look at Tap and Scan

slides.title: The starting point
slides.text: The starting point One interface can’t serve every user Other AAC apps interface, usually designed for direct-select users Bravo interfaces, each built for how its user communicates

slides.title: Two design goals
slides.text: Two design goals Flexibility and efficiency Tap · ultimate flexibility Scan · ultimate efficiency

slides.title: Tap vs. Scan · Selecting
slides.text: Tap vs. Scan · Selecting How an option gets chosen  Tap The user taps an option on the screen.  Scan The user usually presses a switch. Tapping the screen works too.

slides.title: Tap vs. Scan · Selecting
slides.text: Tap vs. Scan · Selecting The auditory scanning loop 1 · Highlight Option is read to the user, usually on a personal speaker 2 · Decide Does the user press the switch? 3 · Announce Spoken aloud on the system speaker Next option Bravo moves on and highlights it Yes No

slides.title: Tap vs. Scan · Building a message
slides.text: Tap vs. Scan · Building a message Building blocks or whole phrases Tap: building blocks I want go park Choose individual words or small phrases Scan: phrases I want to go to the park Select a more developed phrase in one choice

slides.title: Tap vs. Scan · The grid
slides.text: Tap vs. Scan · The grid Flexible grid, basic grid Tap: choose exactly how many options to show. Enough to choose from, never overwhelming. Scan: a simple grid. The count matters less, because options are scanned.

slides.title: Tap vs. Scan · Images
slides.text: Tap vs. Scan · Images Pictures on, pictures off Tap Images by default Turn them off for users who can read the options. Scan Text by default Turn images on for users who like to watch the screen.

slides.title:  In both interfaces
slides.text:  In both interfaces Wake Word works everywhere A partner asks a question, and Bravo generates options to respond.

slides.title: Summary
slides.text: Summary Tap and Scan at a glance Tap Scan Designed for Ultimate flexibility Ultimate efficiency Selecting Tap the screen Switch, or tap the screen Strategy Building blocks: words, small phrases Developed phrases Grid Flexible: exact number of options Basic: count matters less Images On by default, can turn off Off by default, can turn on Wake Word Yes

slides.title: Scan interface tour
slides.text: Scan interface tour The Scan screen, part by part Title Lock Speech History Speech Options Status Message

slides.title: Scan interface tour
slides.text: Scan interface tour Title, Lock and Status 1 Title: the page you’re on, like Home or Greetings 2 Lock: opens the Admin toolbar. Default PIN 1234 . 5 Status: what Bravo is doing right now

slides.title: Scan interface tour · 3
slides.text: Scan interface tour · 3 Speech History Shows every option that has been selected and announced. Clear Empties the box Copy Copies options for texting or email Maximize Bigger text, readable from a distance

slides.title: Scan interface tour · 4
slides.text: Scan interface tour · 4 Speech Options Illustration: the orange outline marks the option being scanned Set by the Admin, or generated by AI AI options show and read a short summary Selected: Bravo announces the full option A navigation target opens that page

slides.title: Tap interface tour
slides.text: Tap interface tour The Tap screen, part by part Home button Speech History Message tools Boards Static options Dynamic options Lock

slides.title: Tap interface tour · 1 and 2
slides.text: Tap interface tour · 1 and 2 Home and Speech History 1 · Home Returns to the Home board 2 · Speech History Shows the message being built. Tap it to announce it.

slides.title: Tap interface tour · 3 Message tools
slides.text: Tap interface tour · 3 Message tools Editing the message 1 · Clean Up AI makes the message conversational without changing the idea want park → I want to go to the park 2 · Backspace Removes the last option added 3 · Clear Empties the Speech History

slides.title: Tap interface tour · 3 Message tools
slides.text: Tap interface tour · 3 Message tools Preview, History and word forms 4 · Preview First tap plays at 50% volume. Tap again to announce at full volume. 5 · History Recent messages to announce again or copy 6 · Past tense see becomes saw 7 · Plural toy becomes toys

slides.title: Tap interface tour · 4
slides.text: Tap interface tour · 4 Boards Tap a board to switch to it. Some have sub-boards. Scroll the strip to see more boards Boards button shows them all on one screen

slides.title: Tap interface tour · 5 and 6
slides.text: Tap interface tour · 5 and 6 Static and dynamic options Static: defined on the board Dynamic: purple outline, AI predicts the next option More Options: next page of static options, fresh dynamic ones Selecting announces it, and may open another board

slides.text: Tap interface tour · 7 Lock and Status Lock Opens the Admin toolbar. Default PIN 1234 . Status message Shows what Bravo is doing, including what it hears when the Wake Word is active

title: How Does Bravo Use AI?
blurb: And what makes it different from other AAC apps that use AI

slides.title: How does Bravo use AI?
slides.text: How does Bravo use AI? And what makes it different from other AAC apps that use AI

slides.title: AI and AAC
slides.text: AI and AAC A very natural partnership LLM Large Language Model When people say “AI” today, they mostly mean Large Language Models, or LLMs.

slides.title: AI and AAC
slides.text: AI and AAC How an LLM works Identify natural patterns in language Understand how those patterns work Predict the next likely option AAC does exactly the same: analyze the pattern, then predict the next option.

slides.title: AI and AAC
slides.text: AI and AAC Two jobs AI can do  Generate options for the user to select and communicate  Build the boards creating pages and filling them with options

slides.title: AI and AAC
slides.text: AI and AAC Building a Greetings board Before AI 1 Search the web for “10 common greetings” 2 Create a new page called Greetings 3 Add the options, one at a time With AI 1 Tell Bravo the board’s purpose: “Greetings” AI finds the options, builds the board and adds them for you.

slides.title: What makes Bravo different
slides.text: What makes Bravo different Four unique AI features Layers of context in every AI prompt AI prompts in buttons not just in page building Next options generated after every selection Wake Word turns a partner’s words into a prompt

slides.title: Feature 1 · Context
slides.text: Feature 1 · Context What is context? Context gives the AI prompt more information, so it can generate more nuanced options. Greetings Happy Greetings Christmas Greetings

slides.title: Feature 1 · Context
slides.text: Feature 1 · Context Multiple layers of context Right now Mood Location People nearby Activity Date Time About the user Favorite topics Least favorite topics Recent activities Upcoming activities Any of these can shape how and what we communicate.

slides.title: Feature 1 · Context
slides.text: Feature 1 · Context Same moment, different mood Mood: happy “Good morning!” Mood: tired “Not ready for today”

slides.title: Feature 1 · Context
slides.text: Feature 1 · Context Where context comes from  The Admin enters most of the context  The user picks their mood when the app starts  Bravo can improve it over time from what the user selects, if enabled

slides.title:  Completely optional. Never shared.
slides.text:  Completely optional. Never shared. Every layer of context is optional, and Bravo still generates dynamic options without any of it.

slides.title: Feature 2 · AI prompts in buttons
slides.text: Feature 2 · AI prompts in buttons A button can hold an AI prompt Example prompts on the Scan interface “Generate greetings based on current location” “Generate ways to describe something positive” “Generate jokes”

slides.title: Feature 2 · AI prompts in buttons
slides.text: Feature 2 · AI prompts in buttons What happens when it’s selected User selects the button Prompt plus any context goes to the AI AI generates options and builds the page Bravo opens the new page

slides.title: Feature 2 · AI prompts in buttons
slides.text: Feature 2 · AI prompts in buttons greetings pages for 10 moods button that builds the page for today’s mood

slides.title: Feature 3 · Next options · Scan
slides.text: Feature 3 · Next options · Scan Scan: phrases that keep it going User selects I want to go outside Bravo can offer Do you want to go outside too? A full set of phrases to continue the message and engage the partner.

slides.title: Feature 3 · Next options · Tap
slides.text: Feature 3 · Next options · Tap Tap: the next building blocks want to go outside New options appear in the Dynamic row, outlined in purple.

slides.title: Feature 4 · Wake Word
slides.text: Feature 4 · Wake Word AAC’s big challenge: responding When a partner asks a question in traditional AAC:  Not programmed A good answer may simply not exist on any board  Yes or no The question gets boiled down to a simple yes or no  Too slow The answer exists, but takes time to find

slides.title: Feature 4 · Wake Word
slides.text: Feature 4 · Wake Word Bravo generates the answers  Partner says the Wake Word, then asks or comments  Their words become an AI prompt  Response options appear, ready to choose The status message shows Bravo is listening

slides.title: Recap
slides.text: Recap How Bravo’s AI is different Feature What it does 1 · Layers of context Mood, location, people, topics and more shape every option 2 · Prompts in buttons One button builds a fresh page, on demand 3 · Next options New phrases or building blocks after each selection 4 · Wake Word A partner’s question becomes response options All context is optional, and never shared.
